faqs.a:
The Model Traffic Code is hereby amended by adding section 1203 to Part 12 to read
               as follows:
1203. Parking in fire lane prohibited.
It shall be unlawful for any person to park a vehicle, or for the owner or person
                  in charge of any vehicle to cause or knowingly permit the vehicle to be parked within
                  the city in any area designated by sign or other clearly visible marking as a fire
                  lane or a fire apparatus access roadway, except for a police vehicle, an ambulance,
                  or a fire truck or other fire apparatus vehicle being used to respond to a fire or
                  other emergency.
(
Ord. No. 4384, § 2, 4-15-2013
)
